|strategy=By [mailto:DougRed4@aol.com Doug Taylor]<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/coruscant/light/small/freondrevan.html</ref>

Freon. You know you've heard that name before. Freon... isn't that the stuff that they use in refrigerators? Well, this guy may not actually be a coolant system, but he's got a few freezing tricks of his own up his sleeve.

Been bothered by an opponent that has [[Gailid]] or [[Mosep]] hanging out at [[Jabba]]'s Palace, wreaking havoc by making you lose cards from your Reserve Deck to big Force drains? Both of these guys are stopped cold by [[Freon Drevan]]. He doesn't even have to engage them directly. By simply chillin' next door to the A/C (Audience Chamber, not Air Conditioning), he can put their nasty game texts on ice.

But that's not even the best ability of this vengeful alien! He's at his best when you deploy him to a crucial location that you need to win battles at, like the Bunker with [[Rebel Strike Team / Garrison Destroyed{{!}}Rebel Strike Team]] or [[Watto]]'s Junkyard with [[The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone / We'll Need A New One{{!}}The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone]]. He simply guarantees that you get through up to 2 battle destiny draws, without fear of them being canceled. Even the mighty [[Darth Vader{{!}}Vader]]/[[Grand Moff Tarkin{{!}}Tarkin]] combo is helpless to stop Light Side destiny draws

Besides all that, he gives you power of 3 and forfeit of 4, all for a measly deploy cost of 2. Pretty good stats on their own, independent of his great game text.

What more could you ask for in an ally for your heroes? When it comes to those critical moments in battles where you really need to hurt your opponent, Freon's the guy you want in the trenches. The dude's got icewater in his veins.
